description:
This resource will work closely with our internal engineers on normally scheduled feature work for Online Store. This work will include Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, and CSS programming , implemented using all standard GODADDY and Online Store processes and procedures. The resource will be present for all team ceremonies, including daily standup meetings, demos, retrospectives, and sprint planning sessions.

 Desired Qualifications: 
 Passion for quality, user experience, and cutting edge web technologies
 Very strong object-oriented programming and design fundamentals
 Strong JavaScript and CSS fundamentals
 5+ years professional web development experience in related technologies
 3+ years Ruby on Rails experience
 2+ years professional JavaScript experience
 Experience with Git/Github 
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills
 Strong understanding of software security best practices
 Experience building software using Agile concepts and processes

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ months 
 Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
